arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: pod drift (shaft power vs boat power vs heart rate), course length (radio), (2) spot drag/weed/rudder (push_local drop within a leg, boat/shaft ratio drop) and clear it, (3) check critical power from heart rate once settled (HR climbing at steady power = above CP), (4) answer the paddler. Baseline boat/shaft ratio about 0.65 (110/170). Do not cue without evidence; save cues.
